QuestInfo.name: Get Well Grandpa Clock
QuestInfo.0: Grandpa Clock clock is vibrant again when he is wound up. But his movement is strange.
QuestInfo.1: According to Grandpa Clock, a cog inside of him is rusted and it is making it difficult to walk. Go get  #r#t4009088##k for him.
QuestInfo.2: You've obtained the  #r#t4009088##k for Grandpa Clock.

0.0: I can feel my energy returning now that I have some new springs. But...huh, I can feel something getting stuck. Ah, some of my parts are rusty. Oh look, this cog is REALLY rusty! Ha.
0.1: I should have had my parts replaced sooner. I've been too lazy... Well, I can get it done now, IF you can lend a hand?

yes.0: Let's see how many cogs I need... One, two three... thirteen, fourteen.... Ah, 15 #r#t4009088##r items should be enough.

no.0: Oh, you're too busy? That's a shame, especially since I can't move.

1.0: Oh my, you brought shiny new cogs! I'll feel new again in no time.

default.0: What's it like to have my parts go bad? Oh, it's the worst! Ha. If you bring me #r15#k #r#t4009088##k items then I'll let you try my rotten cogs. Kidding, kidding.
